value.text: Place your Form G-1450 ON TOP of your application, petition, or request package.

body.p: NOTE:Â Failure to provide the requested information may result in DHS and your financial institution not accepting the payment.Â DHS cannot process credit card payments without an authorized signature.

value.text: We recommend that you print or save a copy of your completed Form G-1450 to review in the future and for your records.
